architecture.mechanism: Smart control of power transfer using local frequency measurements to improve stability and reduce fluctuations.
architecture.intervention: Implement a localized smart control module in the Sentra body electrical system to monitor bus voltage frequency and dynamically regulate charge/discharge cycles between the main battery and auxiliary capacitors, stabilizing power delivery to door locks, windows, and the backup camera during transient loads.
architecture.expected_effect: Elimination of intermittent electrical failures by reducing voltage fluctuations during transients and increasing the critical clearing time for electrical faults across the affected subsystems.
architecture.falsification_test: Induce a high-current transient load on the vehicle electrical bus while monitoring voltage at the door lock actuator; the failure is falsified if voltage drops below 9V for more than 50ms despite the active control module.
